description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'EventBusTenantManagementAdapter' which facilitates handling tenant management requests received via Vert.x event bus. It routes messages based on the operation type (create, get, update, delete, or custom) and interacts with a 'TenantManagementService' to perform these operations. The class also provides utility methods for payload validation, adding default values, and span management for tracing.

classes.name: EventBusTenantManagementAdapter
classes.description: An abstract class providing a base implementation for handling tenant management messages over Vert.x event bus, routing operations to a 'TenantManagementService', with support for span tracing and payload validation.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain the tenant management service instance.

methods.name: processRequest
methods.description: Processes incoming tenant management requests by delegating to specific handlers based on operation type.

methods.name: isValidRequestPayload
methods.description: Validates if the provided payload conforms to the Tenant class's validity requirements.

methods.name: addNotPresentFieldsWithDefaultValuesForTenant
methods.description: Adds default values for optional fields if absent in the tenant payload.

methods.name: processCustomTenantMessage
methods.description: Handles custom or unsupported tenant operations by default failing with a 400 error.
